falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF's price increases by 5% or more over the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained upward move would contradict the blowoff top pattern and invalidate the HOLD signal

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume remains below 20% of the 60-day average for the entire 14-day period
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Inadequate volume would disprove the blowoff condition requiring extreme volatility

falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF's price closes above the 50-day moving average for all 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent strength above key technical support would refute the blowoff pattern's expected breakdown

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
